title: docs(spec): navigation.size says what 'auto' really does
body:
Fixes #36468
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As8yeqbR9TKANdPKRxt

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 写视图配置的人和 AI 在说明文字里看到的抽屉宽度「自动」含义改为实情：固定默认宽度，不再声称按字段数推导；界面行为不变，用户无感。
- 为写元数据的 AI 解决：旧说明描述了一个早已不存在的行为，会误导它对抽屉宽度的判断。
- 出错只影响说明文字，不改任何键、取值或默认值，可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

The `navigation.size` TSDoc and `.describe()` in `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` said that the default `'auto'` makes the renderer derive the drawer size from the object's field count and the viewport, so "AI writes nothing". Measured on `origin/main` 6a731859, no renderer does that. The text now says what each record overlay that reads `navigation.size` actually does:

| Surface | `'auto'` (or absent) resolves to | Where |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Console record side panel (an object's list; the drawer level over a record page) | `min(92vw, 460px)`, fixed, whatever the field count | `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDrawerContext.ts:96`, `:132-137` (`recordPaneWidth`); called from `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts:259` and `recordDrawerStack.tsx:954` |
| Page-block drawers: grid, kanban, calendar, gantt, tree | `resolveOverlayWidth` answers `undefined` for `'auto'` (`ui/packages/react/src/hooks/useNavigationOverlay.ts:177-183`), and the host passes `RECORD_OVERLAY_DEFAULT_WIDTH` = `min(960px, 60vw)` (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordDetailPanel.tsx:265`; `ObjectGrid.tsx:4103`, `ObjectKanban.tsx:2182`, `ObjectCalendar.tsx:1675`, `ObjectGantt.tsx:2441`, `ObjectTree.tsx:1256`) | |
| Page-block drawers: list, gallery, map, timeline | the same `undefined`, spread straight into `NavigationOverlay`, whose own fallback is `42rem` (`ui/packages/components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx:600`) | |

Explicit buckets are `min(92vw, CAP)` with sm 480, md 720, lg 960, xl 1200, full 1600 (`ui/packages/plugin-view/src/recordSurface.ts:50-51`, mirrored in `useNavigationOverlay.ts:162-168`). A width the reader drags wins over either (`navigation-overlay.tsx:598`). Below the `sm` breakpoint the drawer is full width (`navigation-overlay.tsx:709`), and on a phone the console opens every record as a page (`objectViewRecordNavigation.ts:238`).

The field-count derivation still exists as `deriveOverlaySize`, reached by `overlayWidthFor` only when it is handed `'auto'`, and no caller hands it `'auto'`: `recordPaneWidth` returns the 460 px default before calling it. Existing pins on main hold this: `recordPreviewWidth-36149.test.tsx:212` (`recordPaneWidth({ size: 'auto' }, {})` is `min(92vw, 460px)`) and `animation-notification-spec-parity.test.tsx:164` (`resolveOverlayWidth` of `'auto'` is `undefined`).

The clause "aligned with `FormView.modalSize`" is dropped: on main `modalSize` is `sm | default | lg | xl | full` and maps to `sm:max-w-sm` … `sm:max-w-5xl` / `95vw` (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx:340-346`), so it shares neither the bucket names nor the widths. `modalSize` itself is not touched.

Files:

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`: TSDoc and `.describe()` of `navigation.size`.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts`: the view form's `navigation.size` help text, which `view-form-composite-children.test.ts` holds equal to the `.describe()`. It is not on the claim's file surface; the pin makes it part of the same text.
- `content/docs/references/ui/{view,component}.mdx`: regenerated (`gen:docs`).
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.metadata-forms.generated.ts`: regenerated (`check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write --filter=platform-objects`).
- `.changeset/36468-navigation-size-auto-describe.md`: `patch` for `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/platform-objects` (both ship the text).

Prose only: no key, value, default or shape changes; `check:authorable-surface` is green and the authorable-surface base did not move.

Read first: `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` (the `size` hunk, the claim it makes about each host is the risk), then `packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts` (the mirror must stay byte-equal).

Two-minute check: `git grep -c "derives from field count" origin/main -- packages content` lists 13 lines in five files; `git grep -c "derives from field count" HEAD -- packages content` on this branch lists none.

## Acceptance notes

- The zh-CN help text of this key still states the old behaviour, in two copies: `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts:1390` (a hand-written translated value, no source-hash entry, so no gate reds) and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-zh-cn.ts:477` (copied leaf for leaf from the first). Left for the seat: the translation is outside this claim's file surface and `ui/**` is read-only here.
- Stale comments (no behaviour): `recordSurface.ts:17-21` and `:63-66` and `useNavigationOverlay.ts:153-156` still describe the field-count derivation as the `'auto'` path; `ui/e2e/toast-under-modal.spec.ts:287` says `ObjectView` passes `overlayWidthFor(...)`.
- The deprecated `navigation.width` TSDoc says it is "kept only as a renderer fallback", but both resolvers let an authored `width` win over `size` (`recordDrawerContext.ts:134`, `useNavigationOverlay.ts:179`).
